data.name: Ghafr
data.gender_notes: Ghafr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ghafr is an Arabic name derived from the word 'Ghafara' which means 'to cover, conceal, or forgive'. In Islamic tradition, Ghafr is the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, who forgives sins. The name Ghafr carries the meaning “Forgiveness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghafr usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiveness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of Allah's mercy and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Ghafr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiveness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghafr total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: غفر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني المغفرة والعفو
in_arabic.long_meaning: غفر هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، مشتق من الفعل 'غَفَرَ' الذي يعني التغطية والستر، ومنه المغفرة وهي التغطية للذنوب والعفو عنها. ورد اسم الله غافر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَغْفِرُ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدىٰ' (الشورى: 25).

in_urdu.name: غفر
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک، مطلب معافی اور عفو
in_urdu.long_meaning: غفر اللہ کے ان ناموں میں سے ہے جو اس کی رحمت اور عفو کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'غَفَرَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے چھپانا یا ڈھانپنا، یعنی پاپوں کو چھپانا اور ان سے گذشتہ۔ قرآن مجید میں اس نام کا ذکر کئی بار ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ الشورى میں: 'وَيَغْفِرُ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدىٰ' (الشورى: 25)۔

in_hindi.name: غفر
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान के सुंदर नामों में से एक, अर्थात् क्षमा और माफी
in_hindi.long_meaning: غفر भगवान के उन नामों में से एक है जो उसकी दया और माफी को प्रकट करते हैं। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'غَفَرَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है छुपाना या ढाँकना, यानी पापों को छुपाना और उनसे गुजरना। कुरआन-ए-करीम में इस नाम का उल्लेख कई बार हुआ है, जैसे सूर-ए-शूरा में: 'وَيَغْفِرُ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدىٰ' (الشورى: 25)।

in_pashto.name: غفر
in_pashto.meaning: د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو، معنی يې بخښنه او مښول
in_pashto.long_meaning: غفر د الله تعالی د نومونو څخه دی چی د هغه رحمت او مښول ښيي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل 'غَفَرَ' څخه اخیستی دی، چي معنی یې پټول یا ډاڼکول دي، یعنې ګناهونه پټول او هغو څخه تیریږی. په قرآن کریم کی ددی نوم ذکر څو ځله شوی دی، لکه د شوریٰ سورې کی: 'وَيَغْفِرُ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدىٰ' (الشورى: 25)۔

in_english.name: Ghafr
in_english.meaning: One of God's beautiful names, meaning forgiveness and pardon
in_english.long_meaning: Ghafr is one of the names of God that reflects His mercy and forgiveness. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'غ-ف-ر' (gh-f-r), which means to cover or forgive. In the Quran, the name Ghafr appears several times, emphasizing God's forgiveness and pardon for those who repent and turn to Him. The term 'Ghafir' (غافِر) is also used in the Quran to describe God as the Forgiver.

It represents the concept of mercy, compassion, and forgiveness which are integral aspects of the Islamic faith. In the everyday life of Muslims, the name Ghafr serves as a constant reminder of Allah's mercy and forgiveness, and the importance of seeking forgiveness from Allah and from those we have wronged.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ghafr lies in the concept of Allah's mercy and forgiveness. Muslims believe that Allah is the Most Merciful and Most Forgiving, and that He forgives sins through His infinite mercy and compassion. Ghafr is also a reminder of the importance of seeking forgiveness from Allah and from those we have wronged. It encourages Muslims to reflect on their actions, make amends for any wrongs they have done, and strive to live in a manner pleasing to Allah. Thus, the name Ghafr inspires a sense of humility, repentance, and a deep spiritual gratitude towards Allah's infinite mercy and forgiveness.
